# Stretched By Angel

> Professional assisted stretching and personal training on the Gold Coast,
> Australia. Sessions delivered by certified stretch therapist and qualified
> personal trainer Angel Elliott (10+ years experience). In-studio at Wicked
> Bodz Fitness Centre in Surfers Paradise, mobile home visits across all Gold
> Coast suburbs, and online coaching worldwide.

## Core pages

- [Home — Assisted Stretching Gold Coast](https://stretchedbyangel.com/): Service overview, benefits of PNF stretching, single-session and 10-pack pricing, FAQs, and booking details.
- [Personal Training Gold Coast](https://stretchedbyangel.com/personal-training): In-person and online personal training with Angel Elliott. 10+ years experience, training options, FAQs.
- [Areas I Service](https://stretchedbyangel.com/areas-i-service): Hub linking to per-suburb stretching and personal training pages across 77 Gold Coast suburbs.

## Services and pricing

- Assisted PNF stretching, 30 minutes: $60 AUD
- Assisted PNF stretching, 50 minutes: $90 AUD
- 50-minute home visit: $110 AUD
- 10-session pack (30 min): $550 AUD ($55/session)
- 10-session pack (50 min): $800 AUD ($80/session); +$20/session for home visits
- In-person personal training at Wicked Bodz Fitness Centre, Surfers Paradise
- Online personal training and custom programs (worldwide, contact for pricing)
